scientific_integrity: Constructive stationary proof, mathematical integral identity, and exact rational independent checks. Independent scientific validation and priority audit have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional stable Metzler drift and nonnegative input/readout; independent symmetric telegraph drives of common positive switching rate; general signed linear observables may have positive fourth cumulants. No large-network uniformity or higher-order distributional identity with matched Gaussian input is proved. Prior general moment formulas may partially imply the finding.
title: Strict fourth-cumulant signs and fast-flip laws in cooperative telegraph-driven networks
